title: PTE Study question-bank item — schema v2
description: One authored item, not a bank bundle. Runtime validation is authoritative.
$comment: Standard JSON Schema cannot compare two property values. x-pte-semanticRules declares that additional runtime rule; editor validation alone cannot approve content.

x-pte-semanticRules.rule: Foundation answer and transcript, when both present, must be exactly equal (including drafts).

Runtime enforces task-specific cross-field rules including authored speaker identities, coherent token truth, image MIME/extension and alt-text pairing, correct option counts, unique stable IDs, segment/blank alignment, answer membership, and complete reorder permutations. Publication also enforces the existing SST and HIW duration policies. This schema extension is additive and does not declare new tasks practice-ready.
